tour.welcomeTitle: Welcome to Urban Air Quality Assistant
tour.welcomeBody: Take a quick 7-step tour to see how live air readings turn into clear daily actions for your family.
tour.whyHint: Tip: Tap 'Why this advice?' above to inspect the exact live data, reasoning, and medical disclaimer behind today's guidance.

location.title: Pick any city or locality in India
location.body: Search any neighbourhood, tap Use my location, or pick a quick-pick chip. We fetch real-time air quality and weather first — never mock numbers.

snapshot.title: Verify live air data & freshness
snapshot.body: See CPCB AQI (with icon and text category), PM2.5, PM10, dominant pollutant, weather, exact data source, and timestamp.
snapshot.fallback: Pick a city or try a demo persona to see the live air snapshot appear here.

profile.title: Personalize for your household
profile.body: Set household type, commute, outdoor habits, health sensitivities, and home setup — or load one of the 3 one-click demo personas.

planner.title: Today's Verdict & Daily Planner
planner.body: Get one clear verdict sentence up top, followed by morning, afternoon, and evening actions with mask guidance and estimated exposure reductions.
planner.fallback: Your personalized daily planner appears here right after live air data loads.

indoor.title: Indoor Air Quality Guide
indoor.body: Know whether to seal windows or ventilate briefly, where to run a purifier, cooking ventilation tips, and an optional indoor PM2.5 field.
indoor.fallback: The indoor guide tailors to your home setup once a city is loaded.

sustainableChat.title: Low-emission swaps & grounded Q&A
sustainableChat.body: Compare practical low-emission routine swaps with estimated CO₂/PM savings, and ask specific questions grounded strictly in live data.
sustainableChat.fallback: Ask live-grounded questions about your family's schedule here after loading a city.

headerActions.title: Alerts, Settings, Help & Optional Sign-In
headerActions.guestBody: Guest mode works with zero login. Use the Bell for live in-app alerts, Settings for Hindi/dark/accessibility modes, ? for Help, or Sign in anytime to sync up to 5 locations and push alerts.
headerActions.signedInBody: You are signed in! Your profile, preferences, and saved locations sync automatically. Use the Bell for alerts, Settings for thresholds and accessibility, or ? for Help.

help.heading: Help & Guide
help.subtitle: Quick start, privacy-enhanced video walkthrough, FAQ, air-quality glossary, and troubleshooting.

auth.pageTitle: Sign in to Urban Air Quality Assistant
auth.pageSubtitle: Save your household profile, track up to 5 Indian cities, and receive proactive smog alerts — or keep using full guest mode with zero login.
auth.benefit1Body: Keep your commute, sensitivities, and home air setup synced across phone and laptop.
auth.benefit2Body: Switch between home, office, school, or parents' city in one tap.
auth.benefit3Body: Set custom AQI thresholds, quiet hours, and receive browser push & in-app alerts.
auth.benefit4Body: Export all your stored account data as JSON or delete your account permanently anytime.
auth.resetSent: Password reset link sent. Please check your email inbox.
auth.privacyNote: We store only your household profile, app preferences, up to 5 saved Indian locations, and alert settings strictly under your private account. Export or delete everything anytime in Settings.
